deviations_from_card: opensFinder takes (keyEvent, typing) rather than one object with targetIsTyping, to save first-paint bytes. The recent list lives in Console.tsx (a module-level list updated on each path change), not in the depth store, which is outside the write set. The finder's bar control is drawn only in the scene shape, because in the page shape Rust clips this document to the band and an overlay would not be visible. No ADR: the card names none.
notes: First paint measured as HEAD vs HEAD plus this change only (production builds into the scratchpad; my two first-paint files swapped back to HEAD for the baseline): 164,244 -> 164,724 B gz (+480 B, all in the root chunk), under the 165,412 ceiling, leaving 688 B. The ceiling was not raised. The coordinator should run pnpm perf:all (the card lists it; the finder animates opacity/transform and is off under Calm). Guards 6 and 7 were red before too, because they assert the new lazy chunk (6) and import the new Summon (7). Their real conditions (the first frame not carrying finder/places; escapeRises unchanged) held before the change. No sibling reds were seen.
